profile.summary: Santa Cruz Shakespeare is a nonprofit theatre company in Santa Cruz, California. It produces a summer festival of Shakespeare plays and works by other playwrights. It also offers education programs, including youth classes and camps, student matinees, touring school performances, and lesson plans and training for teachers.
